column1: # The OPSD paper's baseline arms, one per line, tab-separated. opsd_baselines.sh and baseline_report.py read this file.
# - agent: the agent dir in the main-track repo (agents/<agent>); zip: its validated zip in /scratch/$USER/gemma4/submissions.
# - first_run: the run name of the arm's first run, as submit_baseline.sh names it: <agent>_<v>_zip. {v} stands for
#   the wheelhouse version the runs are on (v28, v29, ...), so one row names the arm's runs on every version. Later
#   runs are <first_run>_r<k>, where k counts all of the arm's runs. extra_runs: other runs of the same files ("-" if none).
# - ref: the arm baseline_report.py compares against, task by task.
# - kaggle: the same zip's public-board scores, one per wheelhouse version, as v<N>:k/n separated by commas ("-" if
#   none). A score compares only with runs on its own version.
